description:
My name is Sara

I’m excited to introduce our team and our project, “Abandoned, But Not Forgotten” — a storytelling initiative exploring the history of NASA’s discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars.

As someone interested in technology, coding, artificial intelligence, and space exploration.

Through this project, our team aims to bring these forgotten pieces of space exploration back into the spotlight, exploring their history, scientific purpose, and the legacy they leave behind.
